text:
Alex (CEO): Quick follow-up 14 we didn't get to all strategy Qs in the Q&A. Drop short, specific ones and we'll answer.
Jordan (Growth): Need a one-liner for the website that calls out why teams should migrate from cloud endpoints.
Maya (Head of Product): Try: "Redwood: production-grade inference that lowers unit cost and simplifies operations across hosted, dedicated, and private."
Sam (VP Eng): Can we say Dedicated customers get lower p95 latency out of the box? Need safe phrasing for sales.
Ravi (CTO): Safe claim: "Dedicated gives reserved capacity and optimized routing to reduce p95 vs shared tiers; results vary by model and config."
Priya (Solutions): Customers ask about migration friction: can we quantify effort (days/weeks)?
Maya (Head of Product): Typical small proof-of-concept: <3 days to a working flow; production migration with SE help: 20 weeks depending on compliance needs.
Nina (Legal): Note for sales: don't promise specific uptimes until SLA is signed. Use the public SLA FAQ language.
Jordan (Growth): Competitor messaging: can we call out specific strengths vs hyperscalers without sounding combative?
Alex (CEO): Yes 14 factual and constructive. Example: "Hyperscalers offer global scale; Redwood offers predictable serving economics, fine-grained cost controls, and unified ops for LLMs."
Sam (VP Eng): Roadmap check: which item should we push to the front for Q3 marketing? observability, routing, or quantization?
Maya (Head of Product): Observability (token-level cost drilldowns) first 14 biggest direct signal for customers. Model-variant routing next, quantization follows.
Ravi (CTO): Technical note: quantized kernels need extended regression testing across our model catalog; expect staged release.
Priya (Solutions): For customer decks, can we get a short migration checklist? one slide.
Maya (Head of Product): Will produce a 1-slide checklist: prototype steps, required configs, SE contacts, common gotchas. Sharing in #docs by Friday.
Jordan (Growth): Pricing question: embeddings-heavy apps need a predictable plan. Any update?
Alex (CEO): We're exploring a compute/storage split for embeddings and a pilot discount program for heavy users. No changes automatic for existing accounts.
Nina (Legal): Confirmed 14 all pricing pilots need legal review before outreach.
Sam (VP Eng): Internal metric ask: what should teams measure next quarter to align with company goals?
Maya (Head of Product): Two metrics: time-to-first-successful-query (TTFSQ) and cost per 1M tokens for target customers.
allhands-bot: Reminder: the post-all-hands survey link is in #announcements 764f / please complete.
Alex (CEO): Thanks 14 if anything still open, tag the owner and we'll follow up in the related channel.
